response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, full-stack software craftsman with strong web, mobile, and systems-adjacent experience, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: the job requires 8 years of C++ programming and 5 years building large-scale infrastructure/distributed systems/compute platforms, whereas his career is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js/JavaScript web and product engineering with only a brief ~6-month C/C++ stint at National Instruments and no significant cloud compute platform or infrastructure leadership experience. He also lacks demonstrated technical leadership mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers or owning large-scale cloud architecture decisions.
strengths: Extensive, versatile full-stack engineering background across web, mobile, and desktop
Strong track record of technical mentoring, workshops, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
Founder-level experience building and maintaining a platform on Kubernetes, showing some infra exposure
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) versus the required 8 years
No clear large-scale distributed systems, cloud compute, or hardware architecture ownership at the required depth/scale
No evidence of formal technical leadership role managing project priorities/deadlines across teams at an internal platform scale

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/infrastructure platform ownership
Strong mentoring and cross-functional collaboration experience
